answer: Each identity must pass an activity heartbeat every epoch: a fresh ember task from that epoch's seed, signed under its own key. The inlet accepts each task once, so one heartbeat never covers two identities, and at the epoch summit auditors drop identities with gaps. The kth puppet costs the full 25 credits of work, so 1,000 puppets cost 25,000 credits every epoch, with no reuse, while an honest agent pays one 25-credit heartbeat. A rented heartbeat fails because the ember task binds to the renter's key and fresh seed, so a replay is rejected and the puppet's bond burns.
